retrievalProfile.description: A sun-drenched beach scene juxtaposed with winter motifs, featuring a red-and-white color palette and a decorative snowflake frame.

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, outdoor beach photograph featuring a central subject on a striped towel, framed by a dense white snowflake vignette and topped with organic, hand-drawn typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Red beach accessories contrasting against neutral sand
White snowflake border framing the central photographic subject
Organic script typography integrated into the upper landscape
Repetitive red and white stripe patterns across multiple props
coreInvariants: High-key natural daylight with soft shadows
Vibrant red as the primary thematic color
Intricate white snowflake overlays in the corners and edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure kneeling on a towel, occupying the lower-middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, solid red umbrella on the left side providing a heavy color weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the red umbrella to the central figure, then to the striped ball, and finally up to the script title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sandy beach and scrub-covered dune provide neutral breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral beige and tan (sand and dunes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against a desaturated, high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Organic, fluid cursive script with varying line weights.
letterConstructionRules: Inconsistent x-height for a casual, breezy feel
Connected lowercase letters with exaggerated loops
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'C' with a wide, open curve
Lowercase 'l' and 'b' with tall, thin loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Organic, loose script paired with a rigid, geometric sans-serif for clarity.

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the organic, hand-drawn quality of the primary name.
Provides a clean, modern contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a bright beach scene with a woman in a red floral swimsuit sitting on a red-and-white striped towel, with a red umbrella and striped beach ball, framed by a white snowflake border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-lettered white script for the name in the upper right, followed by a clean white sans-serif subtitle below it.

verificationChecks: Is the snowflake border present and white?
Is the red umbrella positioned on the left?
Is the primary text a white organic script?
Are the red and white stripes consistent across props?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the model
postGenerationChecks: Check that the snowflake border does not obscure the face.
Ensure the red umbrella is a solid, vibrant red.
Verify the script text has a hand-drawn, non-digital appearance.
Confirm the striped towel and ball use the same red/white ratio.
recipe.reuseFormula: Beach Photography + Red/White Striped Props + Snowflake Vignette + Hand-drawn White Script
